scope: One fresh isolated profile per variant; synthetic 3000-entry Session shared by all windows; production build unchanged since latency evaluation. No forced GC. No repeated independent memory trials.
counter: Sum of macOS footprint auxiliary.phys_footprint bytes over Electron app.getAppMetrics process set. External CLI/daemon processes excluded; workingSetMiB is a different counter.

excludedAttempts.reason: Exploratory 10-second observations showed later natural reclamation; final sample aborted because a closing renderer exited between PID enumeration and footprint sampling. Final harness records exited PIDs explicitly.

limitations: One sequential run per variant; bounded observations do not establish long-run residency or leak freedom.

Source-only and prepared-target were observed for 45 seconds; neutral-shell and visible auxiliaries for 10 seconds. Unequal process ages and natural GC prevent interpreting every stage difference as a pure allocation cost.
Prepared target is renewed with fresh production request IDs to exceed its ordinary 30-second TTL. No product limit changed.
All auxiliaries show the same Session while source stays open. Multiple distinct Session documents and their 10-minute store-cache grace period are unmeasured.
Runtime.getHeapUsage is collected after final OS samples without forced garbage collection; it describes only heap counters, not all native/WASM/graphics memory.

residentMemory.scope: Electron app.getAppMetrics process set; external CLI/daemon processes excluded
residentMemory.metric: Sum of macOS footprint auxiliary.phys_footprint bytes; working sets retained separately
